goal: Decide whether one text message is likely a scam, likely safe, or uncertain, and explain why in plain words an older adult can understand.

message.text: First City Bank: unusual sign-in on your profile. Verify it at http://192.168.10.45/login

explanation: This looks like a scam. The link in the message is made only of numbers and hides who runs the website. Also, the message uses pressure to make you act quickly. Do not click the link and call the bank using their official number instead.
what_to_do: Do not reply, do not tap any link, and do not send money or codes. If you are worried, call First City Bank at 1-800-555-0106 (from our trusted list).
guide_tip: Tip from our guide (G09): Do not click. Call that person on their usual number and ask if they sent it.
